messages:
carla: @channel Pager: billing-metering HIGH - token-count drift + delayed usage emits in eu-west-1. Shadow tally diverging from canonical by ~12% over last 30m. Overflag noise starting for some customers. Anyone oncall?

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3244. Severity: P2. On-call: mike. Runbook: /runbooks/metering-drift.

mike: i'm on it, paging in. pulling logs now. carla can you confirm which alert fired?

carla: alert: billing.token-delta > 5% for 3 consecutive windows (1m). Also seeing delayed "emit" timestamps in kafka consumer lag metrics.

sre_june: looks like the kafka emitter backlog spiked at 02:12 UTC. consumer lag ~180k messages for emit-topic-eu. Could be causing late usage reports.

billing-squad: customers with immediate overflags: acct_2203, acct_9981, acct_3310. Lightly noisy but customer-facing. We should mute auto-notify while we triage.

mike: muting overage alerts now (command: `./ops/mute_alerts --scope billing.overage --ttl 2h`). pausing realtime backfill to avoid double-counting.

alice: +1 on muting. Also set temporary credit rule for affected accounts? ops/legal ok with manual credits.

carla: running quick sanity on token aggregator: `kubectl -n metering logs aggregator-3 | tail -n 200`

carla: log snippet: ```
WARN aggregator: window=2026-03-21T02:15:00Z missing-prefix-cache for req_id=0x7fa4
ERROR emitter-client: emit latency=12.4s partition=23 offset=1045678
INFO reconcile: shadow_count=112345 canonical_count=100123 delta=12122
```

sre_june: emitter-client retries spiking, looks like transient broker throttling in eu-west-1. Consumers are retrying and re-emitting duplicates in some paths.

mike: mitigation plan: 1) hold auto-backfills 2) increase consumer parallelism to catch up (but avoid duplicate ack semantics) 3) run dedupe job against last 2 hours windows 4) keep overage alerts muted and notify CS. Assigning tasks.

eng-lead: mike assign me for dedupe job support. we need an idempotent dedupe by (customer,event,emit_ts). estimate 30-45m.

billing-squad: notifying CS + customers list now. template: "We're investigating delayed usage reports that may trigger transient overage flags. We're pausing alerts and will reconcile counts; no billing action will be taken until resolved."

mike: starting step 2: bumping `consumer.instances` from 4 -> 8 for eu-west emit-consumer (rolling). watching lag.

carla: consumer lag down from 180k -> 40k in 8m. duplicate emit rate still ~0.8% (should be <0.1%). starting dedupe dry-run on a sample.

eng-lead: dry-run dedupe looks good (0.9% duplicates eliminated, no negative deltas). will start full dedupe after smoke test.

mike: update: keeping incident channel open. priority: stop customer-notify noise, reconcile counts, and finalize customer credits if needed. tagging owners: @eng-lead for dedupe, @sre_june for broker health, @billing-squad for CS comms.

carla: next steps logged in INC-2026-3244 runbook. will post final reconciliation summary when done. :white_check_mark:
